verdict.rationale: Asking whether a domain registrar ships a built-in AI assistant is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only an MCP server, which lets the user's own external AI assistant manage domains, and an AI Domain Search tool that suggests domain names. Neither is a built-in assistant you can delegate tasks to inside Dynadot, so both are adjacent capabilities that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
